scope: Read-only audit of the one authorized round4 batch; no additional solver/E0/E1/E2 or official scheduling helpers. Post-hoc development comparison, no case routing or portfolio selection.

preparation.scope: one-off spec, Git source and frozen official hash preflight; before batch budget T0; no graph algorithm/solver/evaluator calls

saved_preflight.scope: format and available bytes only; no solver/evaluator execution or production write

feed.scope: local schema and available bytes only; not central acceptance or committed-Git preflight

definitions.compute_load: sum max(1,cycles) for original eligible ops placed on a core/pipe
definitions.pipe_busy: sum final P2 end-start; includes DDR slowdowns on COPY, never Step3 local_makespan
definitions.copy_model: reconstruct no-spill endpoint/core-pair/direct copies from saved graph/plan; compare exact service and bytes with stdout; spill overhead remains separate
definitions.spill_counts: observed MTE operation count minus reconstructed base copies, per core; per-core spill byte attribution is unavailable in saved result fields
definitions.copy_union: union of COPY execution intervals across cores, not sum of each core busy
definitions.release_wait: target COPY_IN actual start minus source COPY_OUT end and fixed500; overlapping waits must not be added to interpret Makespan
definitions.causality: idle/wait observations alone are not proof of a particular memory/priority cause; no counterfactual scores run

comparisons.scope: selected ten development graphs at four cores, not full100/1..5 mean or current central winner claim
